_comment: Seeded by `aios repo-bootstrap` (AIO-602): default-deny file-size gate, fresh (EMPTY) grandfather list. Every file matched by `include` (minus `exclude`) must be <= defaultCap lines (wc -l semantics) — enforced by scripts/check-file-size.mjs. A file may only enter `grandfathered` when the gate is first turned on over pre-existing debt; each value is a ratchet CEILING that only ever moves DOWN (`--ratchet` lowers it automatically) and never up. New files are never grandfathered.
